ety.text: 1877, ‘young or small child’, probably a shortened form of tadpole. The extended meaning ‘small amount’ is first recorded 1915.

senses.d: A small amount; a little bit.
ex: Could you lean the picture to the left just a tad more?

chain.g: of such size, of such measure

ety.text: Inherited from Old Spanish tanto, from Latin tantus.
Perhaps of African origin; compare Proto-Bantu *kɪ̀ntʊ̀ (“little thing, small object”).

es:pelín.gl: bit, tiny, very small (to a small extent; in a small amount) (usually with "un (“a”)")
